findings.issue: No backup scripts exist in the repository — zero pg_dump, Supabase export, or storage backup scripts
findings.impact: Production data relies entirely on Supabase managed backups with no verification or export mechanism. No offline backup to restore from.
findings.fix: Create scripts/pg_dump.sh for on-demand PostgreSQL dumps; create scripts/export-supabase-storage.sh for storage bucket mirroring; add scheduled GitHub workflow for daily exports.

findings.issue: No dedicated backup/restore runbook — restore procedures are scattered across migration and incident runbooks
findings.impact: Operators have no single authoritative document for full disaster recovery, database PITR, storage bucket restore, or tenant-scoped recovery.
findings.fix: Create docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md covering: daily backup verification, PITR procedure, storage bucket export/import, full DR scenario, RTO/RPO commitments.

findings.issue: Supabase Storage files (avatars, file uploads) have no backup coverage
findings.impact: All user-uploaded content exists only in Supabase Storage with no export or backup. Storage bucket corruption or compromise results in permanent data loss.
findings.fix: Add scheduled export script copying Supabase Storage bucket to DO Spaces using Supabase Management API or S3-compatible copy.

findings.issue: No automated backup integrity verification — Supabase managed backup status is never checked
findings.impact: Backup failures go undetected until a restore is attempted, potentially during a real disaster with no valid backup.
findings.fix: Add scheduled GitHub workflow (daily) checking Supabase backup status via Management API. Include row count parity check against key tables.
